study.question: Does the locally useful auxiliary product-context transfer require the occupied-batch mean cotangent, its correctly assigned centered component, or their interaction?
study.hypothesis: The aligned product-only run improves click AUC over blocked shared transfer by0.0005607439352452; its paired example-swap loses0.0005047472109015 while preserving the context-cotangent sum and norm before sparse scatter. Hypothesis: correctly assigned centered variation carries useful transfer beyond a common batch mean. Remove the mean while retaining within-batch variation and compare with mean-only, full and blocked edges. This is a local attribution hypothesis, not established gradient-interference evidence or a new architecture claim. The current incumbent g3-r0034-joint_aligned scored0.668473871997858 versus product-only0.6684156159937658; this study isolates the stronger model's product pathway with its residual pathway blocked, rather than claiming product-only is the strongest model. Joint/aligned repeated source endpoints differ slightly across rounds; regard small differences as provisional and require paired repetitions.

nearest_work.difference: Closest exact local architecture/control. Replace only the auxiliary product-context identity VJP by a declared batch-mean/centered projection; residual gate remains blocked. Full endpoint must reproduce this source.

Prior involutive half-swap preserves the mean, scrambles centered variation and moves it only among paired nonempty rows. New occupied-row projection directly retains/removes the mean and centered terms; it does not permute them. These are different interventions with different norms.

Read archived original text lines257-291, including unnormalized target-conditioned local-activation pooling. Retain its adapted scorer and Dice components, plus the entire inherited joint model. DIN does not establish the proposed auxiliary cotangent decomposition.

Read pinned primary benchmark implementation lines123-222: task-mask sequence hubs and repeated token aggregation/broadcast. No hubs, new tokens, attention layers or forward information exchange are imported. Proposed change is training-only backward attribution at fixed forward capacity.

study.proposed_difference: A parameter-free identity-forward custom autograd Function transforms only the auxiliary product-context input cotangent independently for each auxiliary task. Let m_i=1 for an example with any valid history, n=sum_i m_i, g its incoming cotangent, mu=sum_i(m_i*g_i)/max(n,1), M_i=m_i*mu and C_i=m_i*(g_i-mu). Four cells return g (full), M (mean), C (centered), or exact zeros (blocked). Occupancy is computed only from frozen masks, no labels/IDs/RNG. Full returns the original tensor exactly without projection arithmetic; blocked zeros_like. Mean/centered reductions use FP32, then cast to incoming dtype. Historical has_history gate should make g zero outside occupancy; host must verify. No rescaling. All-empty mean/centered outputs zero. No new state, parameters or inference operations. Projections are intentional surrogate VJPs of an identity forward, not ordinary gradients of the displayed scalar BCE; finite-difference checks of those modes are inappropriate.
predictions: Preflight: full matches the historical product-only endpoint in parameters, state, train/eval probabilities, BCEs and all gradients. At common nonzero diagnostic output weights, other cells match all forward values, buffer updates and private/click/item/scorer derivatives while the auxiliary product-context edge equals the declared oracle.

If centered variation is sufficient, centered_only beats product_blocked and recovers most of product_full minus product_blocked; mean_only recovers less. Preregister descriptive recovery ratio R=(AUC_cell-AUC_blocked)/(AUC_full-AUC_blocked) only if full-minus-blocked>0.0001; R>=0.8 is descriptive near-recovery, not statistical equivalence.

If both components matter, factorial interaction I=AUC_full-AUC_mean-AUC_centered+AUC_blocked is non-negligible. Report I plus mean effects with/without centered and centered effects with/without mean; do not equate nonlinear training interaction with instantaneous gradient nonorthogonality.
No inference-speed or parameter reduction predicted. Mean/centered add three Bxcontext-width backward reductions/broadcasts and FP32 temporaries; measure actual cost.
falsifiers: Failed forward/gradient/state/mask oracle checks invalidate interpretation and require source correction before host training; they are implementation failures, not mechanism refutations.
No positive full-minus-blocked contrast beyond descriptive0.0001 leaves auxiliary transfer benefit unconfirmed in this replay; do not infer recovery ratios.
Mean-only recovers the full benefit while centered-only fails against blocked falsifies the stated centered-sufficiency prediction at this seed.
Neither projected component reproduces full benefit supports possible interaction or projection-induced optimization effects, not a proof of generic supervision uselessness.
A favorable single seed cannot establish repeatable improvement; no claim of statistical significance without independent paired seeds and authorized user-cluster uncertainty.
alternative_explanations: Projection changes cotangent norm and embedding-ID-weighted accumulation; no claim of direction utility independent of magnitude or sparse frequency.
Batch centering is defined in concatenated context coordinates before embedding scatter, not the embedding-parameter metric.
Private derivatives match only at fixed weights; trajectories diverge after shared representations change.
Single frozen-seed exploratory contrast; prior exact replays are not independent repetitions.

Mean gradients remain derived from true task labels and features; mean-only is not a label-independent generic optimization control. Existing rolled-label failure changed private task learning as well.
Prior swap retained all ineligible paired rows and changed cross-example sparse-ID collisions. Mean projection covers every occupied row, including those formerly paired with an empty history.
One-epoch AdamW/Adagrad, dense clipping and BF16 numerical accumulation can affect learning paths; pre-scatter orthogonality does not imply orthogonal sparse parameter updates.
Selection over many validation trajectories can inflate apparent best-model benefit. Imported baseline superiority is historical context, not an attribution contrast for this change.
Official offline actions can include feedback not mature in production; auxiliary labels denote user/category/brand24h events rather than advertisement-specific conversions.
